articles.mainIdea: Redwire Cameras And Sensors Put At Center Of Artemis II Story
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Redwire Cameras And Sensors Put At Center Of Artemis II Story. Redwire (NYSE:RDW) will supply its optical imaging system, navigation cameras, and solar sensor technology for NASA’s Artemis II crewed mission on the Orion spacecraft. The company is producing and testing the Orion Camera System and redundant Coarse Sun Sensors under contracts with Lockheed Martin and Airbus for Artemis missions I to V. This hardware will support core navigation, inspection, and livestream video for what is planned as the first crewed flight in NASA’s Artemis program. For... Related tickers mentioned: AIR.PA, RDW.
